subject: Prep: Exec workshop - site screening & badging plan
body:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmefinancial.com>, security@acmefinancial.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Prep: Exec workshop - site screening & badging plan

Hi Jane / Acme security team —

Thanks again for hosting the executive workshop on July 22. A few logistics items we need to confirm from your side so the day runs smoothly:

- Attendee list (names + DOB or ID type for pre-badging). We have two Redwood execs + three engineers.
- Pre-badging: can badges be pre-printed a day early (July 21) and held at reception?
- Escort requirements: will all visitors require continuous escort, or only access to secure labs?
- Device policy: are guests allowed to bring company laptops or must they be checked/loaner devices provided?
- Photography/camera policy in meeting areas and labs.
- Drop-off/parking instructions for two black car arrivals at 08:45.

Attached: site-map.pdf (venue layout) and a draft visitor-badging-form.xlsx for your team to review. I can complete the attendee manifest once we confirm what ID fields you need.

Short timeline we’re aiming for: badge pickup 08:00–08:30, briefing 08:45–09:00, content 09:00–12:00, lunch 12:00–13:00, labs (if permitted) 13:00–15:00.

If you prefer a quick 10-minute call to lock this, I’m available Monday morning.

Thanks —
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Enterprise Sales Director | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

--

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmefinancial.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmefinancial.com
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prep: Exec workshop - site screening & badging plan

Hi Rohan —

Thanks for the detailed note. Quick responses inline and a few items from our side: 

- We can pre-print badges on July 21. For pre-badging we require full name + government ID type (passport or driver’s license) and the attendee email. DOB is optional but helpful for our check-in.
- Escorting: all visitors are escorted in sensitive areas (labs, hardware rooms). Meeting rooms and open offices do not require an escort.
- Devices: Guests may bring laptops for meeting rooms only. No external devices allowed into labs; loaner devices will be provided by security if needed.
- Camera policy: photos allowed in common areas; not permitted in any labelled secure lab (signage will be posted).
- Parking & drop-off: use Visitor Lot B; we’ll email two parking passes that are valid for date of visit.

Local security lead for the day is Mark Chen (mark.chen@acmefinancial.com). He’ll handle escorts and badge issuance. I’m attaching our venue entrance instructions (venue-entrance-instructions.pdf) and the official visitor policy link below.

We also need a signed NDA on file for exec-level demos. I’ll send a DocuSign link; please route to your legal or signers ahead of time.

Best,
Jane
Jane Doe
Head of Events, Acme Financial
jane.doe@acmefinancial.com

--

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmefinancial.com>, mark.chen@acmefinancial.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prep: Exec workshop - site screening & badging plan

Jane — great, thank you. Attendee manifest attached (attendee-manifest.csv). Key updates:

- Execs arriving: Satya Rao (VIP) — arrival 08:30, passport provided; Claire Huang — arrival 08:40, driver’s license provided.
- Engineers: list included with emails for pre-badge QR generation.
- We’d like pre-printed parking passes emailed to attendees and one-day guest parking hung on the dashboard (if possible).
- For the lab time: we’ll limit equipment to platforms cleared by your security team. Rishi (cc) will review the lab checklist and can be on standby for any quick Qs.

Operational asks: can escorts be scheduled in two blocks (09:45–11:30 and 13:00–15:00) to limit handoffs? Also confirm an express badge pickup window at reception (08:00–08:30) and a dedicated line so execs don’t wait.

We’ll complete the DocuSign NDA once you send the link — legal will turn it around same day.

Attaching: attendee-manifest.csv (names, emails, ID type), and reiterating visitor-badging-form.xlsx for your team to confirm required fields.

Thanks —
Rohan

--

From: Mark Chen <mark.chen@acmefinancial.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prep: Exec workshop - site screening & badging plan

Rohan —

All set from security. Confirming the following: 

- Badge pickup: Reception (Lobby D) 08:00–08:30. We’ll print pre-badges and have an express table for execs.
- Escort schedule: Assigned escorts for your two blocks (09:45–11:30 lead: Sarah Liu; 13:00–15:00 lead: Tom Alvarez). Sarah/Tom will meet guests at Lobby D after badge pickup.
- Parking: Two visitor passes will be emailed to the attendee emails; Valet will be alerted for black car drop-off at 08:30.
- NDA: DocuSign link sent — please sign by EOD July 20.
- Labs: Only cleared devices permitted; Rishi, please send your checklist by July 18 if you need lab exceptions.

Attached: badge-queue-snapshot.png (to show our typical morning flow) and link to the DocuSign envelope below.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/link/XYZ-Exec-NDA

See you on the 22nd.

Mark Chen
Senior Security Operations Manager | Acme Financial
mark.chen@acmefinancial.com
